job.purpose: S-ELEM-PQ/HROW 2026-10-16: closed hrow5_hub-r5d-1a91bcdd1 fails the native pin audit (R 236.3, spread 45.0, TT launch 316.0 on 202 outputs e.g. t_rc1[3], capture 357.3 on 2436 of 3180 inputs e.g. f_pr1[693]; results/physical/s81_hrow_native_0030/native_audit_s81_hc_hrow_0030.json). Cause: inhold/outhold pads but the RTL pin flops float into the core and synthesis merges the three rcq[p] read-command copies. Fix: recipe 3 kit (io_flop_at_pins + pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs + HB2 pads); RTL, outline, pin faces unchanged; 0 cycles added (every port already registered in RTL; pin_regs wrapper opted out with reason). Pass: TT/FF >= 0, DRC 0, native launch <= 220 / capture <= 190 / spread <= 80, hrow_tiles pos PASS / mut FAIL.

pin_regs.reason: The hub RTL already registers every data port at a dedicated boundary flop (inputs f_vrq->lrx pv/pd, f_clr->i_clr, f_ev*->ev_c, f_if*->pflt, f_pr*->pr; outputs t_vrq=grant flop, t_vrs=o_rs, t_rc*=rcq[p], t_flt=o_flt). The native miss is placement (pin flops not at the pins, rcq copies merged), fixed by io_flop_at_pins + pin_reg_split + keep_pin_regs; a generic wrapper would add 2 cycles per hub traversal for no structural gain. 0 cycles added.
